name: Senjogahara marsh: Ryuzu Falls to Yudaki Falls (戦場ヶ原)
why: A flat walk up the Yugawa river from one waterfall to another, across a 1,400 m high marsh on raised boardwalks, with Mount Nantai over the grass.
book: Free, no permit. Tobu bus from Nikko or Tobu-Nikko station towards Yumoto Onsen: get off at Ryuzu-no-taki (about 1 hour), and take the same line back from Yutaki-iriguchi. Toilets at Akanuma and the Yudaki car park.
water: No water on the trail itself: carry 1 litre. Shops and vending machines at Ryuzu Falls, Akanuma and Yumoto Onsen.
dangers: Few shaded areas on the boardwalk: hat and sun cream in summer.
Wet or frosty boards are slippery, especially in October mornings.
Stay on the trail and the boardwalks: the marsh is a protected wetland.
turnaround: No hard turnaround: Akanuma, about halfway, has a bus stop. Check the time of the last bus to Nikko before you set off.

points.name: Ryuzu Falls
points.note: The falls split in two around a rock above Lake Chuzenji, by the bus stop. The trail climbs gently north beside the Yugawa river to Akanuma.

points.name: Senjogahara boardwalk
points.note: Past Akanuma the path becomes raised boardwalks across the open marsh, about 1,400 m up, with Mount Nantai to the east.

points.name: Izumiyadoike pond
points.note: A small spring-fed pond in the forest at the north end of the marsh, with benches: a good place for lunch. Yudaki is 40 minutes on.

points.name: Yudaki Falls
points.note: The 70 m cascade that drains Lake Yunoko, seen from a platform at its foot. Yutaki-iriguchi bus stop is 10 minutes east.
